root_cause: The Docker BuildKit image 'openvinogithubactions.azurecr.io/dockerio/moby/buildkit:buildx-stable-1' is missing from the Azure Container Registry (ACR) mirror used by GitHub Actions. This is an infrastructure/registry issue unrelated to the PR code changes. The image should be present in the ACR mirror for docker/setup-buildx-action to work correctly.
recommended_actions: Verify the BuildKit image is available in the ACR registry: openvinogithubactions.azurecr.io/dockerio/moby/buildkit:buildx-stable-1
Re-push or re-mirror the moby/buildkit:buildx-stable-1 image to the ACR if missing
Retry the merge queue run once the image is restored
prevention_strategies: Monitor ACR image availability and set up alerting for missing mirror images. Consider pinning the buildx version to avoid unexpected tag changes.
